artifact_types: Core Web Vitals and waterfall evidence
threshold table with lab or field label per metric
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Analysis cannot change metrics, thresholds, exclusions, or slices after seeing results without labeling the work exploratory; incomplete or incomparable runs cannot yield a pass claim.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
A frontend performance finding requires a frozen journey, representative device profile, warmup, sample count, distribution, budget, and repeatable trace; one fast or slow run is not evidence.
A benchmark requires frozen cases and versions, matched environment and budgets, warmup, repeated runs, variance, failed-case retention, and exact artifacts; leaderboard point estimates alone fail.
A Web performance claim requires repeated runs with recorded browser, device, network, cache, warmup, sample count, distribution, budget, and target identity; a single Lighthouse score cannot pass.
inputs: Experiment results, metric contract, baseline, statistical assumptions, and known data limits.
A rendered frontend, interaction traces, performance measurements, and device constraints.
Frozen cases, candidate variants, metric contract, environment, and budget.
A web application, controlled sampling environment, network waterfall, and build information.
outputs: Core Web Vitals and waterfall evidence
threshold table with lab or field label per metric
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 4 related modes: Analyze frozen experiment results against declared metrics, variance, failure slices, costs, and decision thresholds without rerunning experiments or approving product changes.; Measure current frontend rendering and interaction performance under a frozen user journey and identify evidence-backed bottlenecks without source repair.; Benchmark supplied model or workflow variants on frozen cases, matched environments, metrics, variance, cost, latency, and evidence without remote submission or product approval.; Measure a frozen Web page or journey for navigation, network, caching, assets, rendering, and Core Web Vitals under declared conditions without repair.
